name: Separator
description: A subtle structural divider for grouping related content without adding another surface.

decorative.description: When true, the separator is hidden from assistive technology. Set false only when the division carries meaning.

className.description: Layout escape hatch only: margin, width, height, flex/grid placement. Do not restyle color or thickness.

render.description: Polymorphic render target, Base UI style. Rarely needed.

forbidden: Do not use Separator as decoration between every item in a dense list.
Do not use Separator to simulate a card border or framed page section.
Do not restyle color or thickness via className.
Do not use vertical Separator without a parent height or stretch context.
Do not make decorative separators accessible to screen readers.

responsive.note: Let separators follow the responsive layout. Hide or change orientation when stacked mobile layouts no longer need a divider.
